def handle_ecgberht_high_seat_say(handler, path, body):
    """POST /api/ecgberht/high_seat_say — TALK to the steward at portfolio
    level (2026-08-07, John: "I don't want to click a new project button —
    I want to just talk to it").

    Routes the utterance through the __dashboard__ project's steward (its
    campaign IS running Anchor, and it carries the auto-opened envelope) with
    the PORTFOLIO: prefix the talk instruction knows. A spoken "start a
    project" comes back as the typed project_create act — the High Seat
    renders the confirm card; nothing is created until John clicks it.
    """
    b = body or {}
    text = (b.get("text") or "").strip()
    if not text:
        handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "empty_text",
                            "message": "Say something and the steward will answer."}, 400)
        return
    if _ecgberht_reject_oversized(handler, text):
        return
    # W2c-2 (2026-09-30): a page with a dialogue says it engages the steward itself — anything but the new-project ask
    # is answered 'talk' at once (no grammar compile, no model call here; Grok's read of W2c-2): the page says it to
    # the Campaign's steward, whose say route applies a Campaign verb first and shows the exchange for the rest. The
    # new-project ask keeps the dashboard steward's confirm card (R11).
    if b.get("verbs_only") and not _NEW_PROJECT_ASK.search(text):
        handler._send_json({"ok": True, "talk": True}, 200)
        return
    # W5 (High Seat, 2026-09-26): a Campaign verb typed on the home is applied on the Campaign record by its own
    # writer (the engine names the act; nothing is sent to a model); anything else talks to the dashboard steward
    from steward_cockpit.campaign_say import say_campaign
    _cd = _campaign_dir()
    if (_cd / "roadmap.json").is_file():
        spoken = say_campaign(str(_cd), text)      # a refusal on a failed compile or a writer error; None = not a verb
        if spoken is not None:
            handler._send_json(spoken, 200 if spoken.get("ok") else 400)
            return
    folder, err, status = _ecgberht_project_folder("__dashboard__")
    if err is not None:
        handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "no_dashboard_steward",
                            "message": "The dashboard steward is not set up — "
                                       "open a project's Seal instead."}, 502)
        return
    args = ["--project", folder, "--converse", "PORTFOLIO: " + text]
    # steward-e1 W2 (E1): the High Seat talks through the SAME converse seam,
    # so the same turn-completion hook rides it — computed over the exact
    # utterance the engine sees (the PORTFOLIO-prefixed text).
    args.extend(["--e1", json.dumps(_e1_bound_payload("PORTFOLIO: " + text))])
    packed = _ecgberht_pack_turns(b.get("turns"))
    if packed:
        args.extend(["--turns", json.dumps(packed)])
    out = _ecgberht_bridge(args, timeout=ECGBERHT_CONVERSE_TIMEOUT_S)
    out = _e1_enforce_turn_close("PORTFOLIO: " + text, out)
    handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 502)

def handle_high_seat_campaign(handler, path, body):
    """POST /api/high-seat/campaign — one act on the Campaign's own record (W3c): move a tier, re-rank,
    rename, date, park with its trigger, unpark, flag, add a part, promote a seed. Token-gated by the
    middleware; refused for any project that is not the Campaign. Every answer is a receipt sentence."""
    b = body or {}
    entry = _campaign_entry_for(str(b.get("pid") or ""))
    if entry is None:
        handler._send_json({"ok": False, "receipt": "only the Campaign takes these acts"}, 404); return
    from steward_cockpit.campaign_acts import act as _act
    out = _act(entry.get("folder_path"), b)
    handler._send_json(out, 200 if out.get("ok") else 400)

def handle_cave_terminal(handler, path, body):
    """POST /api/cave/terminal {backend} - a PLAIN terminal on the Cave of Wonders (his word, 2026-10-02: "just a
    terminal ... you can choose which engine ... the default of the terminal engine ... it will open to dev ... it
    just doesn't have the steward skill running in it"). The engine's own interactive CLI in the workspace root (the
    __dashboard__ project's folder, C:/dev): no worktree, no seed, nothing written back into the tree (plain=True
    holds every shell guard), never the project's remembered engine. The Workbench it replaces is retired."""
    backend = str((body or {}).get("backend") or "").strip() or _aset.get_default_cli()
    if backend not in _CAVE_TERM_ENGINES:
        handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": "unknown engine"}, 400)
        return
    try:
        n = 1 + sum(1 for r in _sessreg.list_sessions() if r.get("plain") and r.get("status") == _sessreg.STATUS_RUNNING)
    except Exception:
        n = 1
    try:
        rec = _termsess.start_session("__dashboard__", "general", backend=backend,
                                      label="Terminal %d" % n, plain=True)
    except _termsess.TerminalSessionError as exc:
        handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, 400)
        return
    except Exception as exc:       # e.g. the spawn cap: said, never a hang
        handler._send_json({"ok": False, "error": str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__}, 409)
        return
    handler._send_json({"ok": True, "session": _cave_term_row(rec)})

    date and link come from the resolver when it points at another record."""

    steps = [s for s in (steps or ()) if isinstance(s, dict)]

    for s in steps:

                    "id": p.get("id"), "kind": kind, "name": p.get("name") or "", "text": r.get("what") or p.get("name") or "",

                        and bool(re.search(r"\b(john|you|me)\b", str(p.get("waiting_on") or "").lower()))),

        # W1 (2026-09-28): a referenced part is closed when its RESOLVED target is — done, cancelled, dropped or

        # stayed the open "next" part while its wrapper was planned). An unavailable target is broken: named, never
        # next. Every reader of a part (the light, the rows, the board's chips and ticks) reads these two flags,
        # never the wrapper's status alone (Grok W1).
        for p in parts:
            p["done"] = p["status"] == "done" or p["target_status"] == "done"
            p["closed"] = p["status"] in ("done", "parked") or p["target_status"] in ("done", "cancelled", "dropped", "parked")
        open_parts = [p for p in parts if not p["closed"] and not p["broken"]]
        dates = sorted(p["date"] for p in open_parts if p["date"])
        out.append({
            "id": sid, "name": s.get("name") or sid, "tier": int(s["tier"]) if s.get("tier") in (1, 2, 3) else None,
            "order": int((own or {}).get("order") or 0), "area": str(s.get("area") or ""),
            "done_when": s.get("done_when") or "", "status": s.get("status") or "",
            "if_then": str(s.get("if_then") or ""),      # the Star Chart's one if-then step, in his words (2026-10-03)
            "parts": parts, "next": open_parts[0] if open_parts else None,
            "needs": [p for p in parts if p["needs_you"]], "next_deadline": dates[0] if dates else "",
            "done_count": sum(1 for p in parts if p["done"]),
            # the pace he drives the goal toward (2026-09-29); the parts' progress. The goal itself has no seat: its
            # components do (his three levels, 2026-09-30)
            "pace": str(s.get("pace") or ""),
            "open_count": len(open_parts), "part_count": sum(1 for p in parts if not p["broken"]),
        })
    out.sort(key=lambda i: (i["tier"] or 9, i["order"], i["name"]))   # an untiered initiative sorts last, its tier shown as missing
    for n, i in enumerate(out, 1):
        i["number"] = n
    return out

def project_facts(entry, today=None):
    """One registry entry → the facts its home row is made of.

    ``needs_you``  the strip's human wait, else the last status's "waiting on you" (the fact
                   behind a needs-you row); ``next`` / ``why`` the strip's next step and its reason;
                   ``summary`` the last persisted status, parsed once, with ``summary_age_s`` (the
                   row's steward line reads it from here, not from the file again); ``dated`` the
                   open steps that carry a ``due`` (soonest first, each with its project);
                   ``nearest_due`` the first of them; ``has_record`` whether any file existed.
    """
    today = today or date.today()
    entry = entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else {}
    pid = str(entry.get("id") or "")
    name = str(entry.get("name") or pid[:8])
    folder = str(entry.get("folder_path") or "").strip()
    out = {"id": pid, "name": name, "href": ("/project/%s" % pid) if pid else "",
           "needs_you": "", "next": "", "why": "", "summary": None, "summary_age_s": None, "dated": [],
           "nearest_due": "", "has_record": False, "folder": folder, "projection": None}
    if not folder or not pid:
        return out
    root = Path(folder)
    # the record may live one folder down (the cockpit's own discovery: the root, or a subfolder with a Face);
    # the card reads the effort touched last and names it (John, 2026-09-27: "I don't see many efforts")
    rel = current_effort(folder)
    if rel:
        root = root / rel
    out["effort"] = rel
    strip = _read_json(root / "strip.json")
    if isinstance(strip, dict):
        out["has_record"] = True
        out["needs_you"] = _real_wait(strip.get("human_wait"))
        out["next"] = str(strip.get("next_recommended") or "").strip()
        out["why"] = str(strip.get("why_next") or "").strip()
    sfile = root / ".ecgberht" / "status-summary.json"
    summ = _read_json(sfile)
    if isinstance(summ, dict):
        out["has_record"] = True
        out["summary"] = summ
        try:
            out["summary_age_s"] = max(0.0, time.time() - sfile.stat().st_mtime)
        except Exception:
            out["summary_age_s"] = None
        plan = summ.get("plan") if isinstance(summ.get("plan"), dict) else {}
        if not out["needs_you"]:
            out["needs_you"] = _real_wait(plan.get("waiting_on_you"))
    rm = _read_json(root / "roadmap.json")
    if isinstance(rm, dict):
        out["has_record"] = True
        if not rel:
            out["projection"] = rm.get("roadmap_projection") or []   # the ROOT record only: a resolver in the same request keys on the project folder
        dated = []
        for s in rm.get("roadmap_projection") or []:
            if not isinstance(s, dict) or s.get("status") not in _OPEN:
                continue
            d = _iso(s.get("due")) if s.get("due") else None
            if d is None:
                continue
            dated.append({"step_id": str(s.get("id") or ""), "name": str(s.get("name") or ""),
                          "due": d.isoformat(), "status": str(s.get("status") or ""),
                          "project_id": pid, "project_name": name})
        dated.sort(key=lambda x: (x["due"], x["name"]))
        out["dated"] = dated
        out["nearest_due"] = dated[0]["due"] if dated else ""
        # W2 (2026-09-28): what closed — every status flip to done with its INSTANT (the event's `at`, else the
        # receipt's date at midnight), one per step (the latest), so the head's "since you last opened" can compare
        # against the real instant of his last page open (Grok W2: the date alone cannot see a second open)
        names_by_id = {str(s.get("id")): str(s.get("name") or s.get("id") or "") for s in rm.get("roadmap_projection") or [] if isinstance(s, dict)}
        closed = {}
        for ev in rm.get("roadmap_events") or []:
            if not isinstance(ev, dict) or ev.get("kind") != "status_flip" or str(ev.get("to") or "") != "done":
                continue
            rc = ev.get("receipt") if isinstance(ev.get("receipt"), dict) else {}
            instant = _instant(ev.get("at")) or _instant(rc.get("when"))
            if instant is None:
                continue
            sid = str(ev.get("step_id") or "")
            closed[sid] = {"step_id": sid, "name": names_by_id.get(sid, sid), "at": instant, "project_name": name, "project_id": pid}
        out["closed_recent"] = sorted(closed.values(), key=lambda x: x["at"])
        # W4 (2026-09-28): the repairs proposed and not yet resolved on his word (the card says "proposed: N corrections")
        try:
            from steward_cockpit.repair import open_proposals as _open_proposals
            props = _open_proposals(rm.get("roadmap_events"))
            out["repair_proposals"] = [{"proposal_id": str(p.get("proposal_id") or ""), "count": int(p.get("count") or 0)} for p in props]
        except Exception:
            out["repair_proposals"] = []
    # W2 (2026-09-28): the age of the wait — from the record, never the strip's last touch: the earliest instrument
    # that set the current wait, else the status summary's own time when it carries it; None when unknown
    out["wait_age_days"] = _wait_age_days(root, out["needs_you"], strip, summ, sfile, today) if out["needs_you"] else None
    # W5 (2026-09-28): where he left — the strip's last leave receipt (W0's, written on the switch he made), re-read
    # against the roadmap as it stands now (how many events since); None when he never left this record
    out["resume"] = _resume(strip, rm if isinstance(rm, dict) else None, rel)
    # W1 of the steward revision (2026-09-28): EVERY effort's wait, not only the effort touched last — Grok's live
    # replay (2026-09-27) showed alternating touches hiding the second MBA effort's review from the home. The card
    # keeps the shown effort for its line; the other efforts' waits ride beside it, each opening its own record.
    out["efforts"], out["efforts_gap"] = _effort_waits(folder, rel, today)
    out["other_waits"] = [x for x in out["efforts"] if x["needs_you"] and x["rel"] != rel]
    if not out["needs_you"] and out["other_waits"]:
        first = out["other_waits"][0]
        out["needs_you"] = "%s: %s" % (first["name"], first["needs_you"])
        out["needs_you_effort"] = first["rel"]
        out["wait_age_days"] = first.get("age_days")     # the promoted wait's own age (Grok W2)
    return out

def _declared_source(source, skill, base):
    """Resolve only this inventory entry, with frozen examples hash-bound."""
    provenance = {k: source.get(k) for k in
                  ('origin', 'freshness', 'captured_at', 'captured_from', 'applicability', 'sha256')}
    if source.get('freshness') == 'frozen-example':
        snapshot = source.get('snapshot')
        digest = source.get('sha256')
        if (not isinstance(snapshot, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{64}', str(digest or ''))
                or not all(source.get(k) for k in ('captured_at', 'captured_from', 'applicability'))):
            return None, provenance, 'Historical source lacks its capture identity or qualification'
        raw = Path(snapshot.replace('\\', '/'))
        target = base / raw
        if (raw.is_absolute() or '..' in raw.parts or any(p.startswith('.') for p in raw.parts)
                or not _inside(target, base / 'sources') or not _allowed(target)
                or not target.is_file() or target.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_TYPES):
            return None, provenance, 'Historical snapshot missing or outside its bundle sources'
        if hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
            return None, provenance, 'Historical snapshot hash mismatch'
        return target.resolve(), provenance, None
    if source.get('freshness') not in (None, 'current-source'):
        return None, provenance, 'Unsupported source freshness'
    target = (_path(source.get('origin'), Path(skill['source']), base)
              or _trusted_origin(source.get('origin'), skill))
    return target, provenance, None if target else 'Missing or outside the declared source inventory'

def resolve_ref(ref, cache=None, lookup=None, with_lead=False):
    """One part → ``{"ref","kind","pid","name","what","state","date","href","lead","broken","gap"}``."""
    cache = cache if isinstance(cache, dict) else {}
    lookup = lookup or _default_lookup
    out = {"ref": str(ref or ""), "kind": "", "pid": "", "name": "", "what": "", "state": "",
           "date": "", "href": "", "lead": "", "broken": True, "gap": ""}
    p = parse_ref(ref)
    if not p:
        out["gap"] = "not a reference the Campaign knows (project: · step: · deliverable: · calendar: · effort:)"
        return out
    out["kind"] = p["kind"]
    if p["kind"] == "calendar":
        out["gap"] = "calendar not connected"
        return out
    entry = _cached(cache, ("entry", p["pid"]), lambda: lookup(p["pid"]))
    if not entry or not entry.get("folder_path"):
        out["pid"] = p["pid"]
        out["gap"] = "no project with id %s" % p["pid"]
        return out
    folder = entry["folder_path"]
    out["pid"] = str(entry.get("id") or p["pid"])
    out["name"] = str(entry.get("name") or out["pid"][:8])
    steps = _projection(folder, cache)
    if p["kind"] == "project":
        out["href"] = "/project/%s" % out["pid"]
        # the same fact the home's rows use: the strip's human wait, else the last status's "waiting on you"
        wait = _strip_wait(folder, cache)
        if not wait:
            plan = _summary(folder, cache).get("plan")
            wait = " ".join(str((plan or {}).get("waiting_on_you") or "").split()) if isinstance(plan, dict) else ""
            wait = (wait[:88].rstrip() + "…") if len(wait) > 90 else wait
        out["state"] = ("waiting on you: " + wait) if wait else ""
        out["date"] = _nearest_due(steps)
        out["broken"] = False
    elif p["kind"] == "effort":
        # one cockpit within the project (2026-09-30): the effort directory with its own Face; its light is the
        # ONE attention flag the steward writes; its date the nearest due of its own roadmap
        from pathlib import Path as _P
        from urllib.parse import quote as _q
        eff = _P(folder) / p["sub"]
        sub_ = str(p["sub"])
        try:
            inside = eff.resolve().parent == _P(folder).resolve()
        except OSError:
            inside = False
        if sub_ in (".", "..") or "\\" in sub_ or "/" in sub_ or not inside:
            out["gap"] = "an effort is one directory inside %s, not '%s'" % (out["name"], sub_)      # Grok's read of W2b: never a path out of the project
            return out
        if not (eff / "ECGBERHT.md").is_file():
            out["gap"] = "no effort '%s' in %s" % (p["sub"], out["name"])
            return out
        title = p["sub"]
        try:
            for ln in (eff / "ECGBERHT.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[:40]:
                if ln.startswith("# "):
                    heading = ln[2:].strip()
                    if heading and not heading.lower().startswith("ecgberht"):
                        title = heading
                    break
        except OSError:
            pass
        out["what"] = title
        out["dir"] = sub_
        out["name"] = "%s · %s" % (out["name"], title)
        out["href"] = "/project/%s?dir=%s" % (out["pid"], _q(p["sub"]))
        try:
            import json as _json
            att = _json.loads((eff / ".ecgberht" / "attention.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            att = {}
        state = str((att or {}).get("state") or "").lower() if isinstance(att, dict) else ""
        reason = " ".join(str((att or {}).get("reason") or "").split()) if isinstance(att, dict) else ""
        reason = (reason[:88].rstrip() + "…") if len(reason) > 90 else reason
        out["state"] = ("waiting on you: " + reason) if state == "needs_you" else ((state.replace("_", " ") + ((": " + reason) if reason else "")) if state else "")
        out["date"] = _nearest_due(_projection(str(eff), cache))
        out["broken"] = False
    elif p["kind"] == "step":
        st = next((s for s in steps or () if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("id") == p["sub"]), None)
        if st is None:
            out["gap"] = ("no step '%s' in %s" % (p["sub"], out["name"])) if steps is not None \
                else ("%s has no readable plan" % out["name"])
            return out
        out["href"] = "/project/%s" % out["pid"]
        out["what"] = str(st.get("name") or p["sub"])
        out["state"] = str(st.get("status") or "")
        # W1 (2026-09-28): the TARGET's own status, typed, so the Campaign's open/next reads the referenced step's
        # truth and never the wrapper's status alone (Grok's live replay: a done target stayed "next")
        out["target_status"] = str(st.get("status") or "")
        if st.get("waiting_on") and st.get("status") in ("waiting", "parked"):
            out["state"] += " · " + str(st.get("waiting_on"))
        out["date"] = str(st.get("due") or "")
        out["broken"] = False
    elif p["kind"] == "deliverable":
        items = _register(folder, cache)
        if not p["sub"].isdigit():
            out["gap"] = "a deliverable part names a row number (deliverable:<pid>/<n>); '%s' is not one" % p["sub"]
            return out
        n = int(p["sub"])
        it = items[n - 1] if 1 <= n <= len(items) else None
        if it is None:
            out["gap"] = "no row %d in %s's register (%d rows)" % (n, out["name"], len(items))
            return out
        out["what"] = str(it.get("what") or "")
        out["href"] = str(it.get("route") or "") or "/project/%s" % out["pid"]
        out["state"] = "current" if it.get("is_current") else ""
        out["broken"] = False
    if with_lead and not out["broken"]:
        out["lead"] = str(_summary(folder, cache).get("lead_line") or "")
    return out

def derive(initiatives, facts=None, seeds=None, working=None, today=None, strip_ages=None, goal_last_at=None,
