    page's place): only that goal's dated parts, deck waits and starvation; seeds and the free moment belong to the
    High Seat's brief. ``dismissed`` is the receipts file read (``read_dismissed``). ``head_lead`` is (pid, part name)
    of the brief's own lead sentence: a part the head already names is never nudged too (Grok W3, RC-3). ``kinds``
    limits the candidates to those kinds (None = all): one lane per item (John, 2026-10-03) - the Cave's interrupt lane
    asks for ``{"dated"}``, its panel and the Star Chart's goal places for the rest, so a dated item shows once."""
    today = today or date.today()
    inits = [i for i in initiatives or () if isinstance(i, dict) and i.get("status") not in ("done", "parked")]
    if scope_goal:
        inits = [i for i in inits if i.get("id") == scope_goal]
    dismissed = dismissed or {}
    working = working or set()
    seeds = [s for s in (seeds if isinstance(seeds, (list, tuple)) else ()) if isinstance(s, dict)]   # rows, never a count
    at_hand = _goals_at_hand(initiatives, working)
    lead_pid, lead_part = (str(head_lead[0] or ""), str(head_lead[1] or "")) if isinstance(head_lead, (list, tuple)) and len(head_lead) == 2 else ("", "")

    def _is_lead(p):
        name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "")
        return bool((lead_pid and p.get("pid") == lead_pid) or (lead_part and name == lead_part))
    cands = []

    def add(kind, subject, fact, text, why, acts, goal=None, rank=0):
        key = fact_key(kind, subject, fact)
        if (kinds is not None and kind not in kinds) or key in dismissed:
            return
        cands.append({"kind": kind, "key": key, "fact": str(fact), "text": text, "why": why, "acts": acts, "goal": goal, "rank": rank})

    # 1. a dated thing near while he is elsewhere
    best = None
    for i in inits:
        for p in i.get("parts") or ():
            if not _open(p) or p.get("broken"):
                continue
            d = _iso(p.get("date"))
            if d is None or d < today or (d - today).days > DATED_WINDOW_DAYS:
                continue
            if not scope_goal and i["id"] in at_hand:
                continue      # his own goal at hand: the head says it, not a nudge
            if best is None or d < best[0]:
                best = (d, i, p)
    if best:
        d, i, p = best
        name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "a part")
        # in the goal's own place the goal is already open on screen: no link to it (Grok W3)
        opens = [{"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s?open=%s" % (campaign_pid, i["id"]), "label": "open the goal"}] if campaign_pid and not scope_goal else []
        if p.get("pid"):
            opens.insert(0, {"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s" % p["pid"], "label": "open the cockpit"})
        add("dated", p.get("id") or name, d.isoformat(),
            "Excuse me: %s is due %s (%s)." % (name, when_words(d, today), i.get("name") or "a goal"),
            "the part's date on the Campaign record: %s" % d.isoformat(), opens, goal=i["id"], rank=1)

    # 2. an initiative that needs him and is only on deck - unless the head's own sentence already leads with it
    for i in inits:
        for p in i.get("parts") or ():
            if _open(p) and p.get("seat") == "deck" and p.get("needs_you") and not _is_lead(p):
                wait = re.sub(r"^waiting on you[:\s]*", "", str(p.get("state") or ""), flags=re.I).strip(" .") or "a wait"
                name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "it")
                add("deck_wait", p.get("id"), wait,
                    "%s waits on you and is only on deck — make it active?" % name,
                    "its record: needs you · %s" % wait[:120],
                    [{"act": "seat", "step": p.get("id"), "seat": "active", "label": "make it active"}] + ([{"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s" % p["pid"], "label": "open"}] if p.get("pid") else []),
                    goal=i["id"], rank=2)
                break

    # 3. a top goal starving
    for i in inits:
        tier = i.get("tier")
        if tier not in STARVE_DAYS or i["id"] in at_hand:
            continue
        ages = [int((strip_ages or {}).get(p.get("pid"), 0) or 0) for p in i.get("parts") or () if p.get("pid")]
        age = max(ages) if ages else 0
        last = (goal_last_at or {}).get(i["id"])
        if not age and last:
            try:
                age = (today - _iso(last)).days if _iso(last) else 0
            except Exception:
                age = 0
        if age >= STARVE_DAYS[tier]:
            # the cockpit offered is the one whose age was quoted when it is unseated, else the first unseated (Grok W3)
            unseated = [p for p in i.get("parts") or () if _open(p) and p.get("kind") in ("project", "effort") and not p.get("seat")]
            unseated.sort(key=lambda p: -int((strip_ages or {}).get(p.get("pid"), 0) or 0))
            cockpit = unseated[0] if unseated else None
            acts = ([{"act": "seat", "step": cockpit.get("id"), "seat": "deck", "label": "put %s on deck" % str(cockpit.get("target") or cockpit.get("text") or "it")[:40]}] if cockpit else [])
            if campaign_pid:
                acts.append({"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s?open=%s" % (campaign_pid, i["id"]), "label": "open the goal"})
            add("starving", i["id"], age // 7,
                "%s is a Tier-%d goal untouched for %d days — %s" % (i.get("name") or "a goal", tier, age, "put one of its cockpits on deck?" if cockpit else "pick it up?"),
                "the strip's anti_starvation_age_days of its cockpits, else the days since its last turn: %d" % age, acts, goal=i["id"], rank=3)

    if not scope_goal:
        # 4. a seed that reads like a goal
        for s in seeds or ():
            text = " ".join(str(s.get("text") or "").split())
            words = text.split()
            if len(words) >= 6 and not text.endswith("?") and (_SEED_VERBS.search(text) or re.search(r"\bby\b", text, re.I)):
                add("seed", s.get("id"), s.get("id"),
                    "the seed ‘%s’ reads like a goal — make it one?" % (text[:90] + ("…" if len(text) > 90 else "")),
                    "a seed on the Campaign's strip, %d words with a verb" % len(words),
                    [{"act": "promote", "seed": s.get("id"), "tier": 2, "area": "", "done_when": text[:200], "label": "make it a goal (tier 2)"}] + ([{"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s" % campaign_pid, "label": "open the seeds"}] if campaign_pid else []),
                    rank=4)
                break
        # 5. a free moment: nothing active, something on deck - never the part whose deck wait he already put off
        # (that would be the same "make it active?" twice)
        put_off = {k.split(":", 2)[1] for k in dismissed if k.startswith("deck_wait:")}
        active = [p for i in inits for p in i.get("parts") or () if _open(p) and p.get("seat") == "active"]
        deck = sorted([(i, p) for i in inits for p in i.get("parts") or () if _open(p) and p.get("seat") == "deck" and str(p.get("id"))[:40] not in put_off and not _is_lead(p)],
                      key=lambda t: (t[1].get("seat_order") if isinstance(t[1].get("seat_order"), int) else 999))
        if not active and deck:
            i, p = deck[0]
            name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "it")
            add("free", p.get("id"), p.get("id"),
                "A free moment: %s is on deck (%s) — make it active?" % (name, i.get("name") or "a goal"),
                "nothing is active; the top of On deck", [{"act": "seat", "step": p.get("id"), "seat": "active", "label": "make it active"}], goal=i["id"], rank=5)

    if not cands:
        return None
    cands.sort(key=lambda c: c["rank"])
    return cands[0]

def _wake_locked(self, fresh, seed, *, send_initial=True,
                     expected_selection=None, expected_session_id=None):
        from steward_cockpit import maintenance
        if maintenance.is_active():
            # Wave 1.6 (Grok R1 F3): every wake path, including the interrupt
            # -> wake path inside say(), stops here; queued words survive.
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "maintenance in progress - the steward resumes after activation; your messages are kept"})
            return False, "maintenance in progress"
        entry = _read_state_entry(self.skey())
        is_fake = self.fake or bool(os.environ.get("STEWARD_COCKPIT_FAKE"))
        history_reference = ""
        if not is_fake:
            try:
                self._recover_legacy_history(entry)
                history_reference = self._history_reference()
                settings, target = self._desired_policy()
                import model_policy
                if expected_selection is not None:
                    if (fresh or target != expected_selection.get("family")
                            or entry.get("cli") != target
                            or entry.get("session_id") != expected_session_id):
                        raise ValueError("Model refresh policy or native session changed before wake.")
                    model_policy.validate_policy(expected_selection.get("requested_policy"))
                    model_policy.launch_args(expected_selection)
                    selection = dict(expected_selection)
                else:
                    target, selection = self._current_selection(settings, target)
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Model policy unavailable: " + str(exc)})
                return False, str(exc)
            if target != entry.get("cli"):
                if entry.get("session_id") and not history_reference:
                    self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Provider change withheld: this older conversation needs its original transcript recovered into project history first. The original session is retained."})
                    return False, "original conversation recovery required before provider change"
                if not self._retain_native_session(entry):
                    return False, "native conversation pointer could not be preserved"
                fresh = True
                if not seed and history_reference:
                    seed = history_reference + RESUME_CONTINUITY
                elif not seed and entry.get("last_text"):
                    seed = "Provider changed. Read the campaign record before continuing. Prior session summary:\n" + entry["last_text"]
            self.cli, self.model_selection = target, selection
            import provider_setup as _provider_setup
            if self.provider_connection["family"] != target:
                self.provider_connection = _provider_setup.selected_for_launch(settings, target)
                self.provider_quality = settings.get("provider_preferences", {}).get("quality", {}).get(target)
            try:
                _provider_setup.require_capacity_choice(settings, self.provider_connection)
            except ValueError as exc:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": str(exc)})
                return False, str(exc)
            if not entry.get("session_id") and (not self.provider_connection["native_default"] or settings.get("provider_preferences", {}).get("quality")):
                try:
                    bound_settings = {**settings, "provider_preferences": {**settings["provider_preferences"],
                                     "quality": {target: self.provider_quality} if self.provider_quality else {}}}
                    self.model_selection = selection = _provider_setup.resolve_quality(target, bound_settings, self.provider_connection)
                except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                    self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Selected provider source is unavailable: " + str(exc)})
                    return False, "selected provider source unavailable"
        held = list(entry.get("pending_queue") or [])
        if held and not self.queue:
            self.queue = held
        stored = None if fresh else entry.get("session_id")
        # a stored id from a --fake run must never be handed to the real CLI
        if stored and self.fake != bool(str(stored).startswith("fake-")):
            stored = None
        if stored and self.cli == "chatgpt" and not self.fake:
            stored = _usage_uuid(stored)
        # Bind the selected resume before its Broker can emit checkpoints or
        # an early terminal error. Fresh/provider-changed wakes clear identity.
        self.session_id = stored
        resuming = bool(stored)

        # Anchor stub seam: the healthcheck / tests set STEWARD_COCKPIT_FAKE=1
        # so the cockpit is exercised through THIS module's stream-json fake
        # (the generic ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD stub speaks a different protocol).
        if is_fake:
            import sys
            cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / "fake_claude.py")]
        else:
            base = _cli_cmd("codex" if self.cli == "chatgpt" else self.cli)
            if not base:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": f"{self.cli} CLI not found on PATH"})
                return False, f"{self.cli} CLI not found"
            persona = ("" if self.general else
                       f"Your name in this interface is {self.steward} - John "
                       "picked that persona; answer to it. ")
            if not self.general and _is_campaign_dir(self.dir) and not _is_cave_dir(self.dir):
                persona += campaign_mode_remit(self.steward)      # the Star Chart's remit (2026-10-03, Grok R1 F8)
            if self.cli in ("chatgpt", "grok"):
                import sys
                bridge = "codex_turn_bridge.py" if self.cli == "chatgpt" else "grok_turn_bridge.py"
                cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / bridge),
                       "--target", self.dir, "--model", selection["model"],
                       "--effort", selection["effort"], "--permission-mode", self.permission_mode]
                if stored:
                    cmd += ["--resume", stored]
                self._bridge_system_prompt = persona + self._contract() + "\n" + history_reference
            elif self.cli == "claude":
                cmd = base + [
                "-p", "--verbose",
                "--input-format", "stream-json",
                "--output-format", "stream-json",
                "--include-partial-messages",
                "--permission-mode", self.permission_mode,
                "--disallowedTools", "AskUserQuestion",
                "--append-system-prompt", persona + self._contract() + "\n" + history_reference,
                "--name", "steward-proto",
                ] + model_policy.launch_args(selection)
                if stored:
                    cmd += ["--resume", stored]
            else:
                return False, self.cli + " cockpit transport is not yet verified; no provider was substituted"
        flags = 0
        if os.name == "nt":
            flags = subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP | subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        try:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd, cwd=self.dir,
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", bufsize=1,
                creationflags=flags,
                env=None if is_fake else self._spawn_env(),
            )
        except Exception as e:
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": f"could not start the steward: {e}"})
            return False, str(e)
        self.proc = proc
        _update_state(self.skey(), {"cli": self.cli, "model_policy": self.model_selection,
                                   "provider_connection": self.provider_connection,
                                   "provider_quality": self.provider_quality,
                                   "policy_override": self.policy_override,
                                   "session_id": stored})

        self.broken = False
        self.busy = False
        self.woke_at = time.time()
        # resume validation: if a resumed process dies within a few seconds
        # (bad session id / rejected flags), clear the id and cold-start once
        if resuming:
            time.sleep(0.1)
            if proc.poll() not in (None, 0):
                if self.cli == "chatgpt" or expected_selection is not None or entry.get("retain_native_on_resume_failure"):
                    self.proc = None
                    self._kill_tree(proc)
                    return False, "stored session could not resume; original identity retained"
                _update_state(self.skey(), {"session_id": None})
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
                            "stored session could not resume - starting fresh"})
                if not self.general:
                    self._emit_resume_pickup(entry, open_only=self.one_conversation)
                return self._wake_locked(fresh=True, seed=seed)
        # kept on self so stop() can JOIN it: the reader's EOF handler writes
        # the durable record, and an unjoined write can trail past stop() into
        # whatever STATE_FILE points at by then (tests/healthcheck swap it —
        # the 2026-09-05 proto-state residue finding)
        self._stdout_thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._read_stdout, args=(proc,), daemon=True)
        self._stdout_thread.start()
        threading.Thread(target=self._read_stderr, args=(proc,), daemon=True).start()
        threading.Thread(target=self._ticker, args=(proc,), daemon=True).start()
        # NOTE: the caller (wake) already holds self._lock, so every send here
        # must be _send_locked - calling _send would re-acquire and deadlock
        initial_prompt = None
        if resuming:
            if not self.one_conversation:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": ("terminal" if self.general else "steward")
                            + " awake - resuming the last session"})
            # context on wake (John, 2026-08-25): instant deterministic pickup
            # from the durable record, then the model's own brief orientation
            # (RESUME_BRIEF also re-asserts the role - audit gap #1 - so the
            # deep campaign-memory discipline can't have drifted away).
            # The Campaign's steward (W5, 2026-10-01) wakes with neither: one
            # conversation, no greeting in the dialogue, no pickup asked - only
            # a question that waits on him is said, on the page (Grok W5).
            if not self.general:
                self._emit_resume_pickup(entry, open_only=self.one_conversation)
                # Wave 1.2: no autonomous resume turn. The brief rides on his
                # next message (human-first); an interrupted turn is reconciled
                # in the same breath.
                prefix = RESUME_QUIET if self.one_conversation else RESUME_BRIEF
                interrupted = entry.get("interrupted") if isinstance(entry.get("interrupted"), dict) else self._interrupted
                if interrupted:
                    when = time.strftime("%H:%M", time.localtime(interrupted.get("at") or time.time()))
                    prefix += (f" INTERRUPTED TURN: your previous turn was ended at {when} "
                               f"({interrupted.get('reason', 'stopped')}); its partial writes may be on disk. "
                               "Verify before repeating any action; do not assume it completed.")
                    self._interrupted = None
                    _update_state(self.skey(), {"interrupted": None})
                self._resume_prefix = prefix
                self._reconcile_submitted_locked(entry)
        elif seed:
            initial_prompt = seed
        elif history_reference:
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "awake - restoring the existing conversation and requirements"})
            initial_prompt = history_reference + RESUME_CONTINUITY
        elif self.general:
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "workbench terminal awake"})
            initial_prompt = (
                "This is the project workbench terminal - a general work "
                "session in this folder, NOT the steward (no campaign duties). "
                "John directs; skills are invoked on his word. Confirm "
                "readiness in one short line.")
        else:
            try:
                from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as campaign
                is_new = not campaign.read_map(self.dir)["goal"].strip()
            except Exception:
                is_new = False
            if is_new:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "steward awake - new effort; describe what you want"})
                initial_prompt = STAND_UP_NEW
            else:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "steward awake - standing up (reading the campaign record)"})
                initial_prompt = STAND_UP
        if send_initial and initial_prompt is not None and not self._send_locked(initial_prompt, origin="control"):
            self.broken = True
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
                        "initial steward prompt was not delivered - session "
                        "closed instead of reporting a false wake"})
            try:
                proc.stdin.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._kill_tree(proc)
            self.proc = None
            self.busy = False
            return False, "initial prompt delivery failed"
        if send_initial and initial_prompt is None and self.queue and not self.busy:
            # Wave 1.2: a resumed steward with his words waiting delivers them
            # now (with the resume brief riding along) — no turn boundary is
            # coming to do it, because no resume turn was spent.
            self._deliver_next_queued_locked()
        return True, "awake"

def _guard_turn(self, block):
        """R2/R3: end a small-mode turn that has grown past the step cap (it is handed to a code job), and a turn
        that writes into a repository a running code job owns (one writer). True when the turn was ended."""
        if self.general or self.code_job or self.fake or not self.busy:
            return False
        reason, note = "", ""
        inp = block.get("input") or {}
        paths = [p for p in ([inp.get("file_path")] + list(inp.get("paths") or [])) if isinstance(p, str) and p.strip()]
        try:
            from steward_cockpit import code_jobs as _cj
            owned = _cj.active_repos()
        except Exception:
            owned = []
        hit = []
        if owned:
            name = block.get("name") or ""
            absolute = [p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(self.dir, p) for p in paths]
            if name in ("Write", "Edit", "NotebookEdit", "file_change", "apply_patch"):
                hit = [p for p in absolute if any(_cj.inside(p, r) for r in owned)]
            elif name in _SHELL_TOOLS:
                # a shell or exec call: a write when it runs inside a busy repository, or names one with a writing verb
                cmd = json.dumps(inp, ensure_ascii=False)[:6000]
                if any(_cj.inside(self.dir, r) for r in owned) and _WRITE_VERBS.search(cmd):
                    hit = [self.dir]
                else:
                    flat = cmd.replace("\\\\", "/").replace("\\", "/").lower()
                    for r in owned:
                        rr = str(r).replace("\\", "/").lower().rstrip("/")
                        if re.search(re.escape(rr) + r"(?:/|[\"' ]|$)", flat) and _WRITE_VERBS.search(cmd):
                            hit = [r]
                            break
            if hit:
                reason = "one writer: a code job is working on that repository"
                note = ("(interface - not John) Your last turn was ended: it wrote %s while a code job owns that "
                        "repository. Do not write there until the job reports; tell John in one line." % hit[0])
        # two-lane step 1 (2026-10-05, Grok + Opus): the cap binds in effort mode too - the slowest stewards were the
        # ones mid-effort, where it was off; the hand-off names the worker that fits the work, never a generic coder
        if not reason and getattr(self, "_turn_origin", "human") == "human" and self._turn_tools > STEP_CAP:
            reason = "past %d tool calls: larger than a conversation turn" % STEP_CAP
            note = ("(interface - not John) Your last turn was ended after %d tool calls: that is work, not a conversation "
                    "turn. Commission it now and come back to John: a code change -> a code job (tools/steward_code_job.py "
                    "start, a short brief and a check); research -> researchPrime; a plan -> Crucible; a review -> Gandalf; "
                    "a build with a failing gate -> Foreman. Then tell John in one line what you sent off and to whom. Do "
                    "not finish the work inline." % self._turn_tools)
            self._stopped_mid_turn = True
        if not reason:
            return False
        with self._lock:
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "%s ended its turn (%s)" % (self.steward or "The steward", reason)})
            out = self._interrupt_turn_locked(reason)
            if isinstance(out, dict) and out.get("ok"):
                self.queue.insert(0, note)
                self._persist_queue()
                self._wake_locked(fresh=False, seed=None)
        return True

def _current_selection(self, settings, target):
        """The selection below, with the steward's conversation effort capped (his word, 2026-10-05: "it should be really
        responsive"; his yes to high, not maximum, for conversation turns - commissioned work keeps maximum: code jobs and
        skill runs launch with their own policy). The cap is ANCHOR_STEWARD_EFFORT (default "high"); a workbench
        terminal keeps the family's highest. Lowering it is a model refresh that keeps the native session."""
        family, selection = self._current_selection_uncapped(settings, target)
        return family, _cap_effort(selection, None if self.general else STEWARD_CONVERSATION_EFFORT)

def _ticker(self, proc):
        while proc is self.proc and proc.poll() is None:
            time.sleep(TICK_CHECK)
            if proc is not self.proc:   # superseded by a newer process
                return
            now = time.time()
            if not self.busy and self._pending_refinement_handoffs:
                if self._retry_refinement_handoffs():
                    with self._lock:
                        self._maybe_drive_locked()
            if self._idle_tick(now):
                return
            # THE DETERMINISTIC STATUS CADENCE (handoff 2026-08-25 #2): fires
            # during the steward's OWN busy turn AND during commissioned/
            # background work — the case the old busy-only trigger missed.
            # Zero-model; pane + universal file, never the conversation.
            if (not self.general and now - self.last_status > TICK_SECONDS
                    and (self.busy or self.queue or self._working_bg())):
                self.last_status = now
                self._status_update()
            # the model-facing cadence nudge (commit + HOLD; the status-table
            # demand is gone — the engine composes the status now)
            if (self.busy
                    and now - self.last_output > TICK_SECONDS
                    and now - self.last_tick > TICK_SECONDS):
                # Wave 1.2: nothing is written into a busy broker any more.
                # Every TICK/REASSERT envelope queued in the pipe became an
                # extra full turn after the running one (Codex r2 F2) and
                # delayed John's next message again. The cadence commit below
                # still keys off last_tick; the role re-assert moves to the
                # resume prefix (Wave 2.1).
                self.last_tick = now
            # commit-as-you-go IS a mechanism now: a dirty tree gets committed
            # on the cadence, independent of whether the model remembers
            if now - self.last_tick < 2:
                self._commit_if_dirty("steward cadence checkpoint")

def _status_update(self, emit=True):
        """The 10-minute status OF RECORD — deterministic, two-part,
        zero-model (the audit's 'status treatment A' grown to commissioned
        runs). TOP: what is running now. BOTTOM: where the whole plan
        stands. Persisted to <cdir>/.ecgberht/status-summary.json — the
        UNIVERSAL file both the cockpit's right pane and the main-dashboard
        project tile read — and (emit=True) sent as a 'status' event the
        client routes to the status pane only, never the conversation."""
        if self.general:
            return False
        # Compose, persist, and emit one generation under one lock. A ticker
        # and a result boundary can request status concurrently; neither may
        # overwrite or replay an older truth after the newer one.
        with self._status_lock:
            try:
                from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as campaign
                status = campaign.compose_status(self.dir, self.state())
            except Exception as exc:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
                            "text": "status compose failed: "
                                    + type(exc).__name__})
                return False
            # (2026-09-04, John) a commissioned run that STOPPED — a model
            # session limit above all — must reach him, never just stop: flip a
            # flag still saying "working" to needs_you with the run's reason,
            # so the High Seat and the rail say "need you", and say it once here.
            try:
                flipped = campaign.raise_halt_attention(self.dir, status)
                if flipped:
                    self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "STOPPED: " + flipped["reason"]})
                    status = campaign.compose_status(self.dir, self.state())
            except Exception:
                pass

            persisted = False
            tmp = None
            try:
                f = Path(self.dir) / ".ecgberht" / "status-summary.json"
                f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                tmp = f.with_name(
                    f.name + ".%s.%s.tmp" %
                    (os.getpid(), threading.get_ident()))
                tmp.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + "\n",
                               encoding="utf-8")
                os.replace(tmp, f)
                persisted = True
            except Exception as exc:
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
                            "text": "status persistence failed: "
                                    + type(exc).__name__})
            finally:
                if tmp is not None:
                    try:
                        tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    except Exception:
                        pass

            # Notification-budget counter (2026-08-25 elegance S-batch, B6
            # bar): count each transition INTO needs_you per local day.
            try:
                cur = str(((status.get("plan") or {}).get("attention")) or "")
                prev = getattr(self, "_last_attention_state", None)
                self._last_attention_state = cur
                if cur == "needs_you" and prev not in (None, "needs_you"):
                    self._delivery_patch(lambda d: d.update(
                        pings={"date": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                               "count": (
                                   d.get("pings", {}).get("count", 0) + 1
                                   if d.get("pings", {}).get("date")
                                   == time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") else 1)}))
            except Exception:
                pass
            if emit:
                self._emit({"t": "status", "status": status})
            return persisted

def _handle(self, ev, proc):
        if proc is not self.proc:
            return   # event from a superseded process - drop it entirely
        t = ev.get("type")
        if self._submitted is not None and t in ("assistant", "stream_event", "result"):
            self._ack_submitted(proc, ev)
        if t == "system" and ev.get("subtype") == "init":
            if proc is not self.proc:
                return
            if not self._retain_native_session(_read_state_entry(self.skey())):
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Native session history could not be preserved; retaining the prior pointer"})
                self.broken = True
                return
            self.session_id = ev.get("session_id")
            # init.model is configuration, not proof of what actually served.
            _update_state(self.skey(), {"session_id": self.session_id, "cli": self.cli,
                                      "model_policy": self.model_selection})
        elif t == "usage_checkpoint":
            self._record_usage_checkpoint(ev)
        elif t == "stream_event":
            inner = ev.get("event", {})
            if inner.get("type") == "content_block_delta":
                delta = inner.get("delta", {})
                if delta.get("type") == "text_delta":
                    self.last_output = time.time()
                    _tm = getattr(self, "_timing", None)
                    if _tm is not None and _tm.get("first_word") is None:
                        _tm["first_word"] = self.last_output
                    self.turn_text += delta.get("text", "")
                    self._emit({"t": "delta", "text": delta.get("text", ""),
                                "tick": self.in_tick})
        elif t == "assistant":
            # tool activity is liveness too - keep the "stuck" light honest
            # through a long tool-only turn (a Foreman/researchPrime wave)
            self.last_output = time.time()
            for block in ev.get("message", {}).get("content", []):
                if block.get("type") == "tool_use":
                    self._turn_had_tools = True
                    self._turn_tools = getattr(self, "_turn_tools", 0) + 1
                    if self._guard_turn(block):
                        return
                    inp = block.get("input") or {}
                    fp = inp.get("file_path")
                    # a Claude edit names one file_path; a Codex file_change names its paths
                    touched = [p for p in (inp.get("paths") or []) if isinstance(p, str) and p.strip()] \
                        if isinstance(inp.get("paths"), list) else []
                    if isinstance(fp, str) and fp.strip():
                        touched.insert(0, fp)
                    if block.get("name") in ("Write", "Edit", "NotebookEdit", "file_change"):
                        self._turn_wrote_files = True
                        refs = getattr(self, "_turn_output_refs", [])
                        for path in touched:
                            if path not in refs:
                                refs.append(path)
                        self._turn_output_refs = refs
                        new = [p for p in touched if p not in self.files]
                        if new:
                            self.files.extend(new)
                            _update_state(self.skey(), {"files": self.files[-40:]})
                    if getattr(self, "_timing", None) is not None:
                        self._timing["tools"] = self._timing.get("tools", 0) + 1
                    self._emit({"t": "tool",
                                "name": block.get("name", "?"),
                                "detail": _tool_detail(block),
                                "tick": self.in_tick})
        elif t == "result":
            if not self._usage_result_allowed(ev):
                return
            if proc is not self.proc:
                return   # re-check: a newer process must own this result
            # (2026-09-04, John) a model session limit is TOLD, never swallowed:
            # an error result is said in the pane with its text, a limit raises
            # the flag so the High Seat says "need you" with the reason.
            err_text = result_error_text(ev)
            if self.model_selection:
                actual = ev.get("model_served") if ev.get("model_attested") is True else None
                source = ev.get("model_source") if isinstance(ev.get("model_source"), str) else None
                if self.cli == "claude" and not err_text:
                    usage_models = ev.get("modelUsage")
                    if isinstance(usage_models, dict) and len(usage_models) == 1:
                        actual, source = next(iter(usage_models)), "cli-recorded"
                requested = self.model_selection.get("model")
                self.model_selection = {**self.model_selection, "model_served": actual,
                                        "model_attested": bool(actual),
                                        "model_source": source if actual else None}
                _update_state(self.skey(), {"model_policy": self.model_selection})
                if actual and requested and not _same_model(requested, actual):
                    self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": f"model served {actual} (requested {requested})"})
            if not err_text:
                self._journal_changed_receipt()
            if err_text:
                limit = _campaign_limit(err_text)
                self._model_limit = ("model session limit: " + err_text) if limit else ""
                self._journal_receipt("turn_error", err_text)
                hint = ev.get("stderr_hint")
                tail_text = ""
                if isinstance(hint, dict) and hint.get("kinds"):
                    tail_text = (" | native diagnostics: " + ", ".join(str(k) for k in hint["kinds"][:4])
                                 + f" ({int(hint.get('lines') or 0)} lines, content withheld)")
                self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": ("MODEL LIMIT: " if limit else
                                                 "the steward's turn ended in an error: ")
                            + err_text + tail_text})
                if limit:
                    try:
                        from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as campaign
                        campaign.write_attention(
                            self.dir, "needs_you", self._model_limit,
                            failure_code="MODEL_LIMIT")
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            accounting = self._record_usage_result(ev)
            if not accounting:
                return
            cost, duration, turn_tokens = accounting["cost"], accounting["duration"], accounting["turn_tokens"]
            # pinned open question: scan the WHOLE final text for the last
            # question-bearing sentence (not just a trailing "?"), so a
            # question mid-paragraph still pins. Tick turns never pin.
            txt = self.turn_text.strip()

            was_tick = self.in_tick
            completed_turn_id = f"{self.cli}:{self.session_id}:{self.epoch}:{self.turns}"
            self._ledger_turn(ev, accounting, completed_turn_id)
            producer_id = getattr(self, "_refinement_producer_id", None)
            # the goal's tag rides THIS turn: read from the text that went to stdin for it (Grok W2: never a slot
            # set at say(), which the next unrelated turn could wear)
            _goal_tag = None if (was_tick or getattr(self, "_turn_origin", "") != "human") else _goal_in(getattr(self, "_last_submitted", ""))
            history_saved = (not txt or was_tick or self._record_conversation(
                "steward", txt, turn_id=completed_turn_id, goal=_goal_tag))
            if (producer_id and getattr(self, "_turn_wrote_files", False) and not was_tick
                    and (Path(self.dir) / "roadmap.json").is_file()):
                payload = {
                    "producer_kind": "conversation", "producer_id": producer_id,
                    "source_ref": "Cockpit conversation " + completed_turn_id,
                    "context": getattr(self, "_refinement_dispatch_context", None),
                    "outputs": list(getattr(self, "_turn_output_refs", [])),
                    "inventory_complete": False,
                    "terminal": "failed" if err_text else "done",
                }
                with self._refinement_pending_lock:
                    self._pending_refinement_handoffs[producer_id] = payload
                    saved = _update_state(self.skey(), {
                        "pending_refinement_handoffs": self._pending_refinement_handoffs})
                if not saved:
                    self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Refinement handoff persistence needs repair; automatic continuation is held."})
            self._retry_refinement_handoffs()

            # The complete result boundary is one arbitration transaction.
            # Exactly one next writer wins: an already accepted human message,
            # one machine nudge, auto-drive, or idle. Status I/O happens only
            # after this decision, so it cannot open an overtaking window.
            with self._lock:
                if proc is not self.proc:
                    return
                pinned_now = False
                question_attention = self._attention()
                if question_attention.get("managed_refinement"):
                    self.open_question = ""
                    self.open_question_kind = ""
                if not was_tick:
                    _all = [s.strip() for s in
                            re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+", txt)      # a line break ends a line such as "Reversible: no"
                            if s.strip()]
                    # two-lane step 2 (2026-10-05, Opus): a question waits on him only when the reply ENDS on it - a "?"
                    # mid-reply (rhetorical, or answered in the next sentence) no longer paints orange
                    sentences = [_all[-1]] if (_all and _all[-1].endswith("?")) else []
                    if sentences and (not question_attention.get("managed_refinement") or
                            question_attention.get("pending_request") or _has_recommendation(txt)):
                        request = question_attention.get("pending_request") or {}
                        step_id = request.get("step_id") or self._read_strip().get("current_step_id")
                        prior = self.question_context if isinstance(self.question_context, dict) else None
                        answered = self._answered_before(sentences[-1], step_id)
                        if answered:
                            # answered means retired: never pinned again; the steward is told once
                            if not answered.get("reask_told_at"):
                                answered["reask_told_at"] = time.time()
                                _update_state(self.skey(), {"question_history": self.question_history})
                                self._reasked_answered = answered
                        else:
                            self.open_question = sentences[-1]
                            self.open_question_kind = _question_kind(
                                self.open_question)
                            # the reshape re-ask keeps the decision's identity; a changed
                            # question while one is open names what it replaces
                            origin_id = prior.get("id") if (prior and self._decision_nudged) else None
                            replaced = (prior if (prior and not origin_id and prior.get("question") != self.open_question
                                        and (prior.get("authorization_scope") or {}).get("step_id") == step_id) else None)
                            self.question_context = save_question_context(self.open_question, txt,
                                asked_at=time.time(), source_ref="Cockpit conversation",
                                scope={"request_id":request.get("id"), "step_id":step_id,
                                       "presentation_id":request.get("presentation_id"),
                                       "source_turn_id":completed_turn_id,
                                       "work_digest":question_attention.get("work_digest")},
                                origin_id=origin_id,
                                what_changed=replaced.get("question") if replaced else None)
                            pinned_now = True

                _update_state(self.skey(), {
                    # The outcome is the conclusion, not the opening of a long
                    # reply. Pickup already applies its own display bound.
                    "last_text": txt[-240:],
                    "last_used": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                    "cli": self.cli,
                    "open_question": self.open_question,
                    "open_question_kind": self.open_question_kind,
                    "question_context": self.question_context,
                    "epoch": self.epoch,
                })
                self.busy = False
                self._record_timing(duration, was_tick)
                if not err_text:
                    self._stopped_mid_turn = False   # a turn that ended on its own: the tree is whole again
                self._emit({"t": "turn_end",
                            "cost_usd": round(cost, 4) if cost is not None else None,
                            "cost_status": "reported" if cost is not None else "unavailable",
                            "tokens": turn_tokens,
                            "duration_s": round(duration),
                            "tick": was_tick})
                self.in_tick = self._ticks_pending > 0
                self._ticks_pending = max(0, self._ticks_pending - 1)

                if not history_saved:
                    self._hold_queue("conversation persistence failed; queued messages retained")
                elif err_text:
                    # Error turns never trigger answer nudges or auto-drive on
                    # the exhausted provider. Only a confirmed unsubmitted/
                    # rejected turn can replay the original message.
                    if limit and not (self.fake or os.environ.get("STEWARD_COCKPIT_FAKE")):
                        try:
                            import anchor_settings
                            settings = anchor_settings.get_launch_settings()
                            excluded = set((self.policy_override or {}).get("failed_families") or [])
                            excluded.add(self.cli)
                            target, selection = self._select_available_policy(settings, self.cli, excluded=excluded)
                            selection = _cap_effort(selection, None if self.general else STEWARD_CONVERSATION_EFFORT)
                            if ev.get("replay_safe") is True and not self._turn_had_tools:
                                seed = self._last_submitted
                            else:
                                self._journal_routing(action="replay_blocked", family=self.cli,
                                    message="Interrupted action state is uncertain; original turn will not be replayed")
                                seed = ("The previous provider stopped mid-turn. Do not run tools or repeat prior actions. "
                                        "Briefly explain that you are the available replacement provider, but the interrupted "
                                        "turn needs confirmation before continuing. Preserve all queued user messages.")
                            if self._rollover_locked(target, settings, seed):
                                self._model_limit = ""
                                return
                        except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
                            self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Model failover stopped: " + str(exc)})
                    self._hold_queue("model turn failed; no automatic replay")
                # Human ingress always outranks automatic retries/drive.
                elif self.queue:
                    self._deliver_next_queued_locked()
                elif (self._human_asked and not txt and not was_tick
                      and not self._answer_nudged and not self.general):
                    self._answer_nudged = True
                    self._human_asked = False
                    self._send_locked(
                        "(interface - not John) You ended without answering "
                        "John in words. Reply now in one or two plain "
                        "sentences.")
                elif (getattr(self, "_reasked_answered", None) and not was_tick
                      and not self.general):
                    entry = self._reasked_answered
                    self._reasked_answered = None
                    when = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(entry.get("answered_at") or 0))
                    self._send_locked(
                        "(interface - not John) John already answered this question at " + when
                        + ": \"" + str(entry.get("answer") or "")[:300]
                        + "\". Do not ask it again; act on his answer.")
                elif (pinned_now and txt and not was_tick
                      and not self.general and not self._decision_nudged
                      and not _has_recommendation(txt)):
                    self._decision_nudged = True
                    self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
                                "text": "decision shape: asked without a "
                                        "recommendation - sent back once"})
                    self._send_locked(
                        "(interface - not John) You put a decision to John "
                        "without a recommendation. Re-ask it now in his shape, "
                        "in plain words and nothing else: two or three "
                        "sentences of context (assume he has been away and "
                        "holds none of it), then what you RECOMMEND and one "
                        "line of why, then the realistic alternatives as bullet "
                        "lines, a phrase each with the trade-off, then the "
                        "question as the LAST line, answerable in one word.")
                else:
                    if txt:
                        self._human_asked = False
                    self._maybe_drive_locked(was_tick, txt)
                # R3 (Grok code F4): a code job's coder is finished when its turn ended and nothing follows it (a
                # failover that keeps working returned above; a queued or driven turn keeps it busy)
                if self.on_turn_done is not None and not self.busy and not self.queue:
                    self._fire_turn_done({"text": txt, "error": err_text or ""})

            # Publish the post-arbitration truth (including a just-started
            # queued/nudge/drive turn) without holding the stdin arbiter lock.
            self._status_update(emit=True)

def _maybe_drive_locked(self, was_tick=False, completed_text=""):
        """Choose and send one drive continuation while holding ``_lock``.

        Human ingress, queued text, nudges, and drive all share this arbiter;
        drive must never stack onto an already accepted turn.
        """
        if (self.busy or self.queue or not self.drive or not self.alive()
                or getattr(self, "_pending_refinement_handoffs", {})):
            return
        from steward_cockpit import maintenance
        if maintenance.is_active():
            return  # Wave 1.6: no self-started turn behind the barrier
        if was_tick:
            return   # a cadence-tick turn is not a step - never counts as drive
        txt = (completed_text or "").strip()
        try:
            from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as campaign
            attention = campaign.read_map(self.dir)["attention"]
        except Exception:
            attention = {"state": "unknown"}
        if attention.get("managed_refinement"):
            if (self._question_contexts(attention) or attention.get("producer_recovery_required")
                    or attention.get("state") == "unknown"):
                return
        elif self.open_question or txt.endswith("?"):
            return
        att = attention.get("state")
        # drive housekeeping lines are status-pane traffic, not conversation
        # (handoff 2026-08-25 #4 — CLI declutter): the tick tag routes them
        if att == "needs_you":
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
                        "text": "drive: campaign flag says needs-you - waiting"})
            return
        if self.auto_count >= self.DRIVE_CAP:
            self.drive = False
            self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
                        "text": f"drive: cap reached ({self.DRIVE_CAP} continues) - pausing; say go to re-arm"})
            return
        self.auto_count += 1
        self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
                    "text": f"drive: continuing ({self.auto_count})"})
        self._send_locked(
            "(drive - not John) Continue. Next step per the plan; stop only "
            "for a decision that is genuinely John's, and if you stop, end "
            "with the question.")

def _idle_tick(self, now):
        """Automatic sleep: quiet (no talk, no work, nothing queued) for
        IDLE_SLEEP_SECONDS -> park the process; resume is seamless. A
        commissioned/background run COUNTS AS WORK: the engine stays awake so
        the 10-minute status keeps flowing while it runs. The Campaign's own
        steward (W5, 2026-10-01: one conversation) takes the same checkpoint
        once per quiet spell and stays awake. True = parked."""
        quiet_since = max(self.last_say, self.last_output, self.woke_at)
        if (self.busy or self.queue or now - quiet_since <= IDLE_SLEEP_SECONDS
                or self._working_bg()):
            return False
        if self.one_conversation and self._idle_marked == quiet_since:
            return False
        # commit-on-idle-close is a real mechanism, not a prompt
        self._commit_if_dirty("steward idle checkpoint" if self.one_conversation
                              else "steward auto-sleep checkpoint")
        if self.one_conversation:
            # it stays up: no leave receipt against an open conversation (Grok
            # W5) - the explicit project switch remains the leave
            self._idle_marked = quiet_since
            return False
        # W0 of the steward revision (2026-09-28): the FALLBACK leave receipt — only when
        # presence still says he is on this project (he never switched away); the explicit
        # switch on the High Seat or another cockpit is the trigger, this is the safety net.
        try:
            from . import presence as _pres
            _pres.leave_if_still_here(
                self.dir, lambda _pid, at: _pres.run_leave(self.dir, at))
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
                    f"steward asleep after {IDLE_SLEEP_SECONDS // 60} "
                    "quiet minutes - everything saved; your next message wakes it"})
        self.stop()
        return True

def stop(self):
        # commit-as-you-go covers an explicit Sleep / shutdown too (finding #4
        # gap): a steward's dirty tree is committed before it parks
        if not self.general and self.alive():
            self._commit_if_dirty("steward checkpoint on sleep")
        # Wave 1.6: close stdin UNDER the ingress lock so a concurrent say()
        # can never be mid-write when the pipe goes away ("delivery failed",
        # broken=True); the wait itself stays outside the lock.
        with self._lock:
            proc = self.proc
            closing = proc is not None and proc.poll() is None
            if closing:
                try:
                    proc.stdin.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        if closing and self.busy:
            self._journal_receipt("steward_stopped", "stopped while a turn was running")
        if closing:
            try:
                proc.wait(timeout=10)
            except Exception:
                self._kill_tree(proc)
        # the reader thread's EOF handler persists state (_hold_queue, the
        # turn-result usage): finish it BEFORE returning, so no state write
        # trails a stop into a since-swapped STATE_FILE
        t = getattr(self, "_stdout_thread", None)
        if t is not None and t is not threading.current_thread():
            t.join(timeout=5)
        # clear busy AND hand back the queue under one lock, so a straggling
        # turn-boundary can't re-set busy=True after we cleared it
        with self._lock:
            self.busy = False
            self._hold_queue("session closed")
        self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "steward asleep"})

def confirm_and_launch(
    folder: str,
    proposal: dict,
    *,
    project_id: str,
    who: str = "john",
    backend: str = "claude",
    directive: Optional[str] = None,
    record_extra: Optional[dict] = None,
    watch: bool = True,
    start_session_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
    read_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
    write_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
    runner_kwargs: Optional[dict] = None,
    auth_ctx: Optional[dict] = None,
    expected_token: Optional[str] = None,
    enforce_auth: bool = False,
    thread_factory: Optional[Callable] = None,
) -> dict:
    """John said go: hash-confirm through the engine, launch the managed
    session with the skill loaded and the brief seeded, and start the watcher
    that will fetch him when the skill needs him.

    Injectable seams (``start_session_fn`` / ``read_fn`` / ``write_fn`` /
    ``thread_factory``) make this fully testable without a live PTY.
    """
    if not proposal or not isinstance(proposal, dict):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "proposal_required"}

    # W4 commission-time manifest lint (steward-chamber plan, F2): a NEW
    # scaffold (born under the manifest convention) without a valid sidecar
    # manifest is a HARD refusal before anything is confirmed or launched;
    # a campaign predating the manifest routes to the W5 brownfield dual
    # path (route "brownfield-w5") and proceeds.
    import chamber_manifest as _cm
    manifest_lint = _cm.commission_time_lint(folder)
    if not manifest_lint.get("ok"):
        return {"ok": False, "error": manifest_lint.get("error"),
                "message": manifest_lint.get("message"),
                "manifest_lint": manifest_lint}

    # W10 E2 enqueue gate (steward-chamber, C5 — ENGINE-ENFORCED on THIS
    # seam, the W2-proven leg b): while the campaign carries a death whose
    # containment-checked sweep card is not yet BOUND into the decision-gate
    # queue, a re-commission is REFUSED with the named finding — before the
    # engine confirm, before any spend. The guard fails CLOSED on an
    # unreadable gate store (a safety gate never guesses).
    import chamber_gates as _cgates
    e2 = _cgates.enqueue_guard(folder)
    if not e2.get("ok"):
        return {"ok": False, "error": e2.get("error"),
                "finding": e2.get("finding"),
                "message": e2.get("message"),
                "blocking_deaths": e2.get("blocking_deaths")}

    confirmed = run_bridge("confirm", {
        "project": str(folder),
        "proposal": proposal,
        "who": who,
    })
    if not confirmed.get("ok"):
        return {"ok": False, "error": confirmed.get("error", "confirm_failed"),
                "message": confirmed.get("message"), "confirm": confirmed}

    job = confirmed.get("job") or {}
    skill = job.get("skill") or proposal.get("skill")
    step_id = job.get("step_id") or proposal.get("step_id")

def _watch_session(folder, project_id, record, *, watch_only,
                   read_fn=None, write_fn=None, runner_kwargs=None) -> dict:
    """One watch: drive (or resume watching) the session, then bring the run
    home through the bridge. Runs on the watcher thread."""
    session_id = record["session_id"]
    if read_fn is None or write_fn is None:
        import terminal_session as _ts
        read_fn = read_fn or _ts.read_since
        write_fn = write_fn or _ts.input

    kwargs = dict(DEFAULT_RUNNER_KWARGS) if runner_kwargs is None else dict(runner_kwargs)
    try:
        result = _cr.run_commissioned_session(
            session_id,
            WORK_TURN,
            read_fn=read_fn,
            write_fn=write_fn,
            watch_only=watch_only,
            **kwargs,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        # (2026-08-07 shark round) A runner exception used to kill the daemon
        # thread SILENTLY — the record stranded "running" forever and John was
        # never fetched. A dead watcher is a died run: report it honestly.
        result = {"outcome": "died", "ran": None, "elapsed_s": None,
                  "transcript": "", "transcript_chars": 0,
                  "watcher_error": str(exc)[:300]}
    return finish_run(folder, project_id, record, result,
                      read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn,
                      runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs)

def finish_run(folder, project_id, record, result, *,
               read_fn=None, write_fn=None, runner_kwargs=None) -> dict:
    """The run stopped: persist the record, then hand it to the engine —
    report, conversation log, raise, handback — via the ingest bridge.
    If the reflection says the next move needs no human input, CARRY ON:
    launch it unasked (John's standing autonomy rule), capped by AUTO_CHAIN_CAP."""
    session_id = record["session_id"]
    transcript = result.get("transcript", "") or ""
    # A re-armed watch must never ERASE the first watch's read (found live
    # 2026-08-06: watch 2 saw only post-snap silence and its thin report
    # replaced the rich verdict). Every prior report is kept.
    prior_reports = list(record.get("prior_reports") or [])
    if isinstance(record.get("report"), dict) and record["report"].get("say"):
        prior_reports.append(record["report"])
    updated = {
        **record,
        "prior_reports": prior_reports,
        "outcome": result.get("outcome"),
        "ran": result.get("ran"),
        "elapsed_s": result.get("elapsed_s"),
        "transcript_chars": result.get("transcript_chars"),
        "transcript_tail": transcript[-TRANSCRIPT_TAIL_CHARS:],
        "watch_count": int(record.get("watch_count", 0)) + 1,
        "at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
    }

    # (steward-chamber W11, E3) THE RESURRECTION GUARD on the W2-proven
    # handback seam: BEFORE the ingest bridge reaches Ecgberht
    # engine/handback-ingest.mjs :: ingestHandback /
    # ingestValidatedHandbackBody, every predicate-bearing correction is
    # re-asserted against the artifact it names. A regression BLOCKS the
    # handback with the named finding; the unassertable remainder rides the
    # report DEMOTED. Fails CLOSED on an unreadable corrections store; a
    # project with zero corrections passes trivially (honest zero report).
    try:
        import chamber_corrections as _ccx
        guard = _ccx.handback_guard(folder)
    except Exception as exc:
        guard = {"ok": False, "blocked": True,
                 "finding": "E3-CORRECTION-REGRESSED-HANDBACK-BLOCKED",
                 "error": "guard-crashed", "message": str(exc)[:200]}
    if guard.get("blocked"):
        updated["handback_blocked"] = guard
        updated["ingest_error"] = guard.get("finding")
        updated["report"] = {
            "say": "Handback BLOCKED (%s): %s"
                   % (guard.get("finding"),
                      guard.get("message") or "correction regression"),
        }
        _atomic_write_json(_run_record_path(folder, session_id), updated)
        return {"ok": False, "record": updated, "blocked": guard,
                "ingest": None}

    ingest = run_bridge("ingest-run", {
        "project": str(folder),
        "project_id": project_id,
        "run": {
            "outcome": result.get("outcome"),
            "transcript": transcript,
            "ran": result.get("ran"),
            "elapsed_s": result.get("elapsed_s"),
            "skill": record.get("skill"),
            "step_id": record.get("step_id"),
            "session_id": session_id,
            "commission_id": record.get("commission_id"),
            "worktree": record.get("worktree_path"),
        },
    }, timeout=INGEST_TIMEOUT_S)

    if ingest.get("ok"):
        updated["report"] = ingest.get("report")
        # (2026-08-07) The frontier reflection: impact, findings fed into the
        # scaffolding, and the composed next-move directive John iterates on.
        updated["reflection"] = ingest.get("reflection")
        updated["raised"] = ingest.get("raised")
        updated["handback"] = (ingest.get("handback") or {}).get("ingested") \
            if isinstance(ingest.get("handback"), dict) else None
    else:
        # The ingest failing is a fact John gets, not a silent swallow.
        updated["report"] = {
            "say": "The run stopped but I could not read it back "
                   f"({ingest.get('error', 'bridge_failed')}). Open the session to see it.",
        }
        updated["ingest_error"] = ingest.get("error")

    if result.get("watcher_error"):
        updated["watcher_error"] = result.get("watcher_error")

    # BANK the terminal state FIRST (2026-08-07 shark round): the auto hop
    # spawns bridge processes and can block for seconds — during which the
    # rest of the system must already see this run as finished, not running.
    _atomic_write_json(_run_record_path(folder, session_id), updated)

    # CARRY ON (2026-08-07): reflection said the next move is fully determined
    # by what is on file — no decision is John's — so launch it now. Only after
    # a clean produced run (asked/died/timeout always come back to him), and
    # never more than AUTO_CHAIN_CAP hops without him touching the campaign.
    updated["auto_continue"] = _maybe_auto_continue(
        folder, project_id, updated, ingest,
        read_fn=read_fn, write_fn=write_fn, runner_kwargs=runner_kwargs)
    if updated["auto_continue"] is not None:
        _atomic_write_json(_run_record_path(folder, session_id), updated)

    # W5 brief precompute (steward chamber): the reflection just landed, so
    # precompute the situation brief into the chamber sidecar NOW — the next
    # Seal open paints it with zero model calls (E8: steward-plane sidecar
    # only; roadmap/receipts/reflection stores untouched). Best-effort by
    # contract — a projector hiccup never blocks a run finishing; the W5
    # cold-open rebuild is the cure. Runs BEFORE the campaign commit so the
    # sidecar rides the same bank.
    try:
        import chamber_reconcile as _chamber_reconcile
        _chamber_reconcile.on_reflection_landing(folder)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # W9 deliverable landing (steward chamber, C2 — ENGINE-FED, never
    # model-remembered): the run just stopped, so if the manifest-declared
    # output now exists CONTAINED on disk, record the W4 deliverable_landing
    # projection NOW — the open chamber's injection-clock poll flips the ◇
    # box live with no reopen. Idempotent per output path; best-effort by
    # the same contract as the brief precompute above (a sidecar hiccup
    # never blocks a run finishing).
    try:
        import chamber_deliverable as _chamber_deliverable
        _chamber_deliverable.record_landing_if_present(folder, updated)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # W10 died→sweep-card state machine (steward-chamber, C5/E2): a run that
    # ended died/quiet/timeout registers SWEEP-PENDING now — from here the
    # E2 gate in confirm_and_launch blocks any re-commission until the
    # containment-checked sweep card is bound into the queue, and a HELD
    # gate is never dropped (the transition never touches the queue head).
    # Best-effort by the same sidecar contract as the hooks above; the E2
    # refusal itself is enforced at the confirm_and_launch seam.
    try:
        if result.get("outcome") in ("died", "quiet", "timeout"):
            import chamber_gates as _cgates
            _cgates.on_run_death(folder, updated)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Hook C (reports-links 2026-09-05 W2): a run that came home PRODUCED
    # registers its human-facing docs (idempotent on the re-armed watch's
    # second finish); asked/died/quiet/timeout runs never register. Runs
    # BEFORE the campaign commit so the register row rides the same bank.
    if result.get("outcome") == _cr.RUN_PRODUCED:
        _register_run_docs(folder, project_id, updated)

    # A finished run changed campaign state (record, attention, log) — bank it.
    commit_campaign_state(
        folder, f"{record.get('skill', 'skill')} run {result.get('outcome')}")
    return {"ok": True, "record": updated, "ingest": ingest}

skill's journal is often a live, unnoticed defect in another — and never trust a
"0 candidates" cycle until you have printed parsed-vs-total, because a broken reader and
a quiet corpus look exactly alike.**

steps.title: Read registry and compact project facts

steps.title: Resolve Campaign goals and components
steps.summary: Read Campaign roadmap and referenced parts; group them under goals with done-when, tiers, paces and deadlines. Referenced state remains owned by the target; missing calendar/project/effort/step is a named gap.

steps.title: Read guides before acting: a qualified duty
steps.summary: The instructions require goals, seats AND guides before other project records. The Campaign context reads guides; the modern Cave context has no equivalent guide loader. This is an operator duty with shared Star Chart code, not an installed Cave call; model-turn compliance is unproved here.

steps.title: Read Active and On deck in John's order
steps.summary: Only interactive components are seated; a seat is not a work authorization. Goal ownership remains in the Campaign. An unseated cockpit can appear among candidates with explicitly heuristic relevance.

steps.title: Choose one act and name the exception
steps.summary: Active waits lead, then On deck waits, Tier-1 due waits, lower-tier waits due today/overdue with an Exception label, Tier-1 waits, then oldest project wait. This proposes attention without rewriting a tier.

steps.title: Offer pickup while Active runs
steps.summary: When every active initiative runs or waits on someone else and none needs John, offer the first On-deck item. A free active initiative defeats this proposal.

steps.title: Derive a boundary suggestion
steps.summary: The page derives non-dated nudges and a separate dated interrupt lane from recorded facts; no model turn. Conditions include a due part within three days, deck waits, Tier-1 seven-day/Tier-2 fourteen-day starvation, seeds and a free moment.

steps.title: John changes priorities or dismisses
steps.summary: Only his act or word changes tier, seat, pace or goal; the Campaign writer records receipts with undo. Not now dismisses a fact until it changes. Opening and seating do not start project work.

steps.title: Open the owning project steward
steps.summary: Follow the referenced cockpit or single contained effort. Portfolio attention does not take ownership of its plan or acceptance. Read that effort's full campaign record before proposing work; missing records are gaps.

steps.title: Use Cave's own dialogue
steps.summary: The modern page embeds /steward/v1 with Campaign pid and dir=Cave of Wonders. Star Chart uses the Campaign root. Both reuse cockpit machinery, but no longer share one transcript.

steps.title: Reuse the keyed persistent engine
steps.summary: get_engine keys the cockpit by directory/session. Wake reads durable history and resolves provider capability before launching hidden CLI transport. Maintenance, unreadable history, missing provider or failed native resume may withhold launch.

steps.title: Route spoken Campaign acts separately
steps.summary: The legacy high_seat_say route handles new-project confirmation and Campaign verbs; verbs_only otherwise returns talk so the client uses a cockpit. handle_post compiles Campaign acts only at Campaign root; Cave effort speech proceeds through its own steward, not that root-only deterministic branch.

steps.title: Answer or propose bounded work
steps.summary: The persistent cockpit say lane uses a tool-enabled subscription session. The optional Node converse lane is read-only and talks/plans via its own hooks; it is not an obligatory call on each Cave turn. Preserve existing authority and unresolved decisions.

steps.title: Optional explicit CLI / index lane
steps.summary: runCli validates an explicitly requested verb and main routes it. The index-only portfolio glance has a separate bounded read contract; its existence does not prove the current page invokes it.

steps.title: Size the authorized request
steps.summary: Small reversible requests default to a direct edit and one discriminating check, roughly three files. Current STEP_CAP defaults to 15 tool calls and binds human-origin steward turns even in effort mode; a code change goes to a code job, research to researchPrime, planning to Crucible, review to Gandalf and a gated build to Foreman. No implicit swarm.

steps.title: Small direct work under the guard
steps.summary: The steward can make an authorized small edit, check and report. The current guard checks ownership heuristically and caps human-origin tool calls even in effort mode; general coders are excluded. It is not a universal sandbox or semaphore.

steps.title: Choose depth without changing model quality
steps.summary: The optional shipped dispatch table defaults to LITE, chooses SPIKE for unknown data shape and FULL only in an explicit high-uncertainty/high-cost cell. steps.title: Code job owns its worktree
steps.summary: start verifies repository/ownership, creates the isolated worktree and launches a general coder. One writer owns that repository. Steward remains responsive; an unavailable model, busy repository or failed launch does not count as running work.

steps.title: Own the watcher and return channel
steps.summary: The long-lived Anchor service watches specialist sessions; code jobs have their own watcher. Ownership, result and errors are returned to the commissioning steward. Background activity is distinct from human wait.

steps.title: Show status; distinguish acknowledgement
steps.summary: The engine ticker defaults to 600 seconds and emits status; the cockpit can acknowledge the rendered generation. Global instructions require ten-minute chat tables while the installed contract uses pane updates. This browser check proves neither live cadence nor delivery in Anchor.

steps.title: Check the code job before landing
steps.summary: On result the job engine runs the commissioned check, commits, merges newer changes inside the isolated worktree and reruns the gate before landing. The stored check_output records only the first gate; a later merge-gate refusal must be reproduced separately. Failed gates, conflicts or ownership prevent successful landing; a process exit alone is not a passing artifact.

steps.title: Recover and inspect the saved result
steps.summary: Skill finish and producer handoff preserve result identity and observation context. Cockpit retries unresolved handoffs. Reconcile delayed completion notices, then continue the current authorized effort. A report still needs content inspection before publication; emitted metadata alone is not review.

steps.title: Read the actual findings and changed claims
steps.summary: The owning steward inspects useful outputs against source and cumulative requirements, applies required findings before dependent review and rechecks changed claims. A model GREEN cannot substitute for a readable product.

steps.title: Apply the existing stakes/family rule
steps.summary: Medium stakes, any Heavy or John's request uses the configured independent family when different. Same-family, absent or uninspected model service stays qualified. Optional Node converse talks once and may plan once; persistent cockpit decision-shape correction retries once. Neither is an adversarial-review round; specialist round limits remain skill-owned.

steps.title: Register the exact version for review
steps.summary: Keep useful reports in the one existing register; managed refinement-update binds products, checks and presentation. Legacy efforts keep qualified existing version history. Prior acceptance does not transfer to this draft.

steps.title: John reviews this product
steps.summary: John's feedback, acceptance, deferral or close is separate for every product. A completed job and technical retries leave this walkthrough Initial draft. Outstanding reviews survive focus changes.

steps.title: Apply cumulative feedback and recheck
steps.summary: The existing refinement writer records feedback. Carry active requirements forward, freeze the correct current version and inspect corrections before dependent checks. Independent authorized work can continue.

steps.title: Accept only the applicable current version
steps.summary: Explicit current-version acceptance or presentation close passes the existing close guards; historical acceptance is not closure of newer work. This display invokes no acceptance or close.

steps.title: Use a named shortfall in the existing pathway
steps.summary: Real use and its named gap feed the existing curated entry plus machine record, formal scoped improvement commissioning/review and verified correction. A current-version usage shortfall is the ticket to construction; no engine wave or automatic promotion is authorized here.

steps.title: Recover without replaying uncertain writes
steps.summary: Preserve native history and exact output; retry unresolved handoffs or check corrected content. Native resume failure retains identity where guarded. A timeout does not by itself prove a stalled provider.

steps.title: Honor stop, pause or bounded drive
steps.summary: John's stop halts the code job and/or persistent engine with recoverable state. Optional auto-drive stops at 50 continuations and is blocked by pending questions, maintenance or recovery. The ordinary 1800-second quiet checkpoint keeps Cave/Campaign one-conversation engines awake; other project cockpits can sleep.

steps.title: Wait with the exact unresolved subject
steps.summary: Keep the required human decision, proposal, independent participation or product feedback open. Other authorized work may proceed; silence and technical output cannot invent acceptance.

steps.title: Report a qualified failure or gap
steps.summary: Missing sources, capability, ownership, stale proposals, failed checks or explicit stop leave a visible limit. Do not infer all-clear, current model service or completion from missing evidence.

steps.title: End the bounded act without product acceptance
steps.summary: A read-only page result, recorded human act, checked small edit or checked code-job artifact can finish its own bounded task. Product acceptance and slice closure remain John's separate decision.
